# Real Ziidi messages. They carry no date, so the arrival time is the transaction time.
# Note the balance gaps between messages: that is daily interest, never reported on its own.

# sender: ZIIDI
# received: 2026-11-12T10:54:30+03:00
# expect: {"kind":"ziidi.invested","reference":"UKC8X1QV16","amount_minor":42800,"balance_after_minor":42852,"occurred_at":"2026-11-12T10:54:30+03:00","date_from_message":false}
You have successfully invested Ksh. 428.00 of transaction code UKC8X1QV16. Your ZIIDI balance is Ksh. 428.52
---
